notes.title: Small update: Full subtitle support.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] All missing subtitles have been added.

[*] The subtitle widget has been redesigned.
[/list]

notes.title: BIG UPDATE.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The dialogue system mechanics have been completely overhauled.

[*] Performance has been improved in problematic areas of the game’s locations.

[*] Lighting in key locations has been reworked.
 
[*] The narrative element has been enhanced in all locations to allow you to piece everything together into a single puzzle.

[*] The number of dialogues has been increased.

[*] Several puzzles have been changed.

[*] Some new visual effects have been added.

[*] A straightforward enemy has been introduced.

[*] 12 bugs have been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Critical Update – Bug Fix
notes.content:
A critical issue in the dialogue system that could block player control has been resolved. We've added the ability to either restart to the main menu or automatically disable the dialogue system in such cases.

Additionally, a new mini-puzzle has been added to the hospital level.

Thank you to those who reported the issue in time — your feedback is greatly appreciated.
